_note: Both forms post to Web3Forms. `action` is the shared endpoint; `accessKey` is the per-inbox key from web3forms.com — it is public by design (it ships in the HTML and only names the destination inbox), so it is fine in this file. If `accessKey` is ever blanked or reset to a PASTE_ placeholder the form falls back to opening the visitor's email client, so nothing is silently lost.

eventIdea.title: Propose an event or mini group
eventIdea.intro: Dreamer sessions, casual catch-ups, hands-on learning, build-together spaces — if you want it to exist, tell us and we'll help make it happen. We read every one, but with a community this size we can't always reply.

sponsor.title: Sponsor or host
sponsor.intro: Venue, food, prizes, hardware or paid sponsorship — all of it helps, and all of it keeps events free for the people who come.
